A VOICE OPERATING LAYER FOR YOUR WORKDAY

Say the work.

FlowMesh is a downloadable Windows app that turns a Wispr Flow dictation into a bounded, reviewable plan. Approve it once; the local runtime performs real actions and shows what actually happened.

Review, then approve ↗

ONE INTENT / THREE SURFACES

Your voice starts it.
Your approval runs it.

01 / SPEAK

Dictate naturally.

Wispr Flow inserts your command into the focused app field. You can type too; FlowMesh never claims to contain Wispr's speech engine.

02 / DECIDE

See the exact plan.

Jev chooses from registered workflows when connected. Local rules are clearly labeled when it is not. Unknown or sensitive requests are rejected.

03 / EXECUTE

Get honest receipts.

The Windows runtime opens approved apps and URLs. Home Assistant can notify your phone and adjust your light; missing connections are shown as not configured.

REAL PRODUCT, REAL BOUNDARIES

No simulated
success states.

The web page you are viewing is a product page, not a fake controller. Real actions happen only in the local Windows app after a one-use plan is approved. Browser launches and phone notifications are marked sent; a lamp is marked verified only after Home Assistant state read-back.
